name: Fighter (2024)
description: Fighters rule many battlefields, sharing an unparalleled prowess with weapons and armor. They are well acquainted with death, both meting it out and defying it.
starting_equipment_options: (A) Chain Mail, Greatsword, Flail, 8 Javelins, Dungeoneer’s Pack, and 4 GP
(B) Studded Leather Armor, Scimitar, Shortsword, Longbow, 20 Arrows, Quiver, Dungeoneer’s Pack, and 11 GP

1.name: Fighting Style
1.description: You have honed your martial prowess and gain a Fighting Style feat of your choice. (Defense is recommended). Whenever you gain a Fighter level, you can replace the feat you chose with a different Fighting Style feat.

1.name: Second Wind
1.description: You have a limited well of physical and mental stamina. As a Bonus Action, regain HP equal to 1d10 + Fighter level. Uses: 2 (regain 1 on Short Rest, all on Long Rest). Increases at levels 4, 10, 16.

1.name: Weapon Mastery
1.description: Use mastery properties of 3 kinds of Simple/Martial weapons. Change one choice on Long Rest. Increases at levels 4, 10, 16.

2.name: Action Surge
2.description: Take one additional action (except Magic action). Once per Short/Long Rest. (Two uses at level 17, but only once per turn).

2.name: Tactical Mind
2.description: When you fail an ability check, expend Second Wind use to roll 1d10 and add to the check. If still fails, Second Wind use is not expended.

3.name: Fighter Subclass
3.description: Gain a Fighter subclass. (Champion is detailed in Basic Rules).

4.name: Ability Score Improvement
4.description: Gain Ability Score Improvement feat or other feat.

5.name: Extra Attack
5.description: Attack twice when taking Attack action.

5.name: Tactical Shift
5.description: When activating Second Wind, move up to half speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks.

6.name: Ability Score Improvement
6.description: Gain Ability Score Improvement feat or other feat.

8.name: Ability Score Improvement
8.description: Gain Ability Score Improvement feat or other feat.

9.name: Indomitable (One Use)
9.description: Reroll a failed saving throw with bonus equal to Fighter level. Once per Long Rest.

9.name: Tactical Master
9.description: When attacking with a weapon whose mastery property you can use, replace it with Push, Sap, or Slow property for that attack.

11.name: Two Extra Attacks
11.description: Attack three times when taking Attack action.

12.name: Ability Score Improvement
12.description: Gain Ability Score Improvement feat or other feat.

13.name: Indomitable (Two Uses)
13.description: Indomitable can be used twice per Long Rest.

13.name: Studied Attacks
13.description: If you miss an attack roll, gain Advantage on next attack roll against that creature before end of your next turn.

14.name: Ability Score Improvement
14.description: Gain Ability Score Improvement feat or other feat.

16.name: Ability Score Improvement
16.description: Gain Ability Score Improvement feat or other feat.

17.name: Action Surge (Two Uses)
17.description: Action Surge can be used twice per Short/Long Rest.

17.name: Indomitable (Three Uses)
17.description: Indomitable can be used three times per Long Rest.

19.name: Epic Boon
19.description: Gain an Epic Boon feat or other feat. (Boon of Combat Prowess recommended).

20.name: Three Extra Attacks
20.description: Attack four times when taking Attack action.
